summary: CCH Holdings Ltd filed Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, reporting concurrent board and officer changes. Effective August 5-7, 2026, independent director Wu Wai Kong, co-CEO and director Mhlengi Prevail Mafu, and director Chung Wai Wong resigned without disagreement; the board accepted the resignations. Appointed in their place were Ms. Hsu Hui Chen as director and co-CEO and Ms. Lim Fei Fern as independent director and Compensation Committee chair, both effective August 7, 2026. Appointments have no specific term and are terminable at will. The changes are abrupt and involve senior leadership, constituting an event-driven management transition.
